camel_example: aliyun dms-enterprise ListTagMetaAsset --region cn-hangzhou --TagName 'sys::DMS-DA::cn-hangzhou::space:abcde' --PageSize 50 --PageNumber 1 --SearchKey test --Tid 3000 --MetaParentId 123456 --MetaType META_DATABASE
description_en: Lists Database and Table assets associated with a specific Tag in a DataAgent Workspace
description_zh: 获取DataAgent协作空间数据中心添加库表信息
kebab_example: aliyun dms-enterprise list-tag-meta-asset --tid 3000 --tag-name sys::DMS-DA::cn-hangzhou::space:abcde --meta-type META_DATABASE --meta-parent-id 123456 --search-key test --page-number 1 --page-size 50 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTagMetaAsset

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the tenant.

> You can find the tenant ID by hovering the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the Data Management Service (DMS) console. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
> 取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The name of the tag. To retrieve database and table assets from a DataAgent Workspace, specify the tag name in the format `sys::DMS-DA::${DataAgentRegionId}::space:${DataAgentWorkspaceId}`
parameters.help_zh: 标签名字，需要获取DataAgent协作空间下的库表信息，传递格式为 `sys::DMS-DA::${DataAgentRegionId}::space:${DataAgentWorkspaceId}`
parameters.name: tag_name

parameters.help_en:
- Specify `META_DATABASE` to retrieve databases.

- Specify `META_TABLE` to retrieve tables in a specific database
parameters.help_zh:
- 获取库列表，传递为 META_DATABASE
- 当获取某个库详情的表列表，传递为 META_TABLE
parameters.name: meta_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the parent asset.

- Omit this parameter to retrieve databases.

- To retrieve tables in a specific database, set this parameter to the `dbId` of the database
parameters.help_zh:
资产对应的父级MetaId：
- 当获取DataAgent数据中心左侧库列表，此值无需传递
- 当获取某个库详情的表列表，此值传递为 对应的 dbId
parameters.name: meta_parent_id

parameters.help_zh: 搜索关键词，支持模糊搜索
parameters.name: search_key

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size
